match_rule: AP register line reference equals the history Reference; the history Transaction Amount (incl GST) is within 2c of the document net ex GST x 1.1 (all register lines on the Document Unique ID); the history Date is within 120 days of the register Doc Date; exactly one creditor code satisfies all three. Tier 1 where the history line carries an 11-digit ABN, else Tier 2 (rule 8).
